- role: indicator, type_designations: ["PUE 7.1", "PUE HY10", "PUE CY10 (5Y)", "PUE HX5.EX"] — alternatives OR.

Model family: the models vary by indicator terminal (xxx = 5Y, HY10, 7.1), maximum range (yyy), pan size (n), design (zzz). Hmm, that's a parametric family. The characteristics vary by configuration (which indicator is used): power supply, protection class differ by terminal.
